en: Ah, so you're here...
......?{PAGE}Marie is, as usual, nowhere to be found...
...Are you looking for Marie? She's{SAUT}conducting an errand for Margaret...

"The Seven Deadly Sins"

...Nngaaaaaaaaaah!

...! N-Nothing!

...Do you have a moment, Inmate?
You know Marie's poems? ...Well... we{SAUT}saw something...
Saw what?{OPTION}Why are you whispering?
Look, just listen!
The one who's always leaving the{SAUT}poems on the floor... is...

Eep!

*chuckle* What an adorable pair.{SAUT}Please, do what you can to keep{SAUT}indulging them.
